name: Eunos
summary: EWL heartland stop between Paya Lebar and Kembangan — mature HDB density, Malay-food gravity, and shorter east-central hops than Tampines without PLQ condo premiums.
body: Eunos is the east shortlist when someone wants East-West Line access and heartland errands without paying full Paya Lebar Quarter rents. Mature HDB blocks, neighbourhood centres, and food strips toward Geylang Serai / Joo Chiat edges define daily life. Expats land here for EWL CBD hops and value; walk evening corridor life and check MCST rules carefully on any condo inserts. Compare with Guillemard for quieter residential texture beside the same broad catchment, Dakota when Circle Line / stadium adjacency matters more, and Paya Lebar when office-mall gravity is the job.
bestFor: EWL CBD hoppers wanting heartland rents
car-light couples okay with estate variance
watchOuts: Block-level variance beside busier food corridors
Geylang-edge texture if you stretch too far
HDB whole-flat vs bedroom approval checks
housingMix: Mature HDB dominant with selective condo inserts.
commuteNotes: East-West Line at Eunos; time Tuesday 08:15 door-to-desk and a rainy walk to the neighbourhood centre.
